remarks.para: This .NET wrapper uses Task.Run to call the synchronous method. Await the task before reusing or disposing of the supplied objects, invoking another helper, or returning from the backup callback.
The helper must not close or seek the state descriptors. Read only the state saved by this helper, so that later helpers can read their own state.
